name: CAP Quote Share
author: MD NAJMUS SHADAT

sections.description:
CAP Quote Share is a lightweight WordPress plugin that lets you copy, share, and download content easily — especially designed for Classic Editor users.

You can create beautiful quote/share boxes and automatically add image download buttons to your site without any configuration.

Shortcode example:
[capqsh]Your quote or caption text here[/capqsh]

Perfect for:
– Quote & caption websites
– Status and motivation blogs
– Image-sharing and content-curation sites
– Classic Editor users

No setup required. Just install and activate.

Key Features

✓ Quote/share boxes with copy-to-clipboard button
✓ Social sharing (Facebook, WhatsApp, Twitter, Messenger)
✓ Works with Classic Editor quote (blockquote)
✓ [capqsh] shortcode support
✓ Automatic image download buttons
✓ Zero configuration
✓ Lightweight & fast
✓ Mobile responsive
✓ Gutenberg compatible
✓ Admin settings panel
✓ No user data tracking

Usage

Method 1: Using Shortcode (Recommended)

Use this shortcode in Classic Editor or Gutenberg:

[capqsh]Your quote or caption text here[/capqsh]

This will automatically create:
– A styled quote box
– Copy-to-clipboard button
– Social share buttons

Method 2: Using Classic Editor Quote Button (❝)

You can also create quote/share boxes directly from the Classic Editor toolbar.

Steps:
1. Select any text in Classic Editor
2. Click the Quote (❝) icon
3. Publish or update the post

The plugin automatically converts blockquote content into a styled quote/share box on the frontend.

→ No shortcode needed
→ Works automatically

Automatic Image Download Buttons

Add images normally using Classic Editor or Gutenberg.

The plugin automatically displays a Download button below each image on the frontend.

You can disable this feature from:
Settings → CAP Quote Share

Settings

Go to Settings → CAP Quote Share to:
– Enable or disable quote/share boxes
– Enable or disable image download buttons

External Services

This plugin adds direct share links to third-party services. When a visitor clicks a share button, only the required data (quote text and/or page URL) is sent.

  • Facebook (facebook.com)
    Data sent: quote text and/or page URL
    Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms.php
    Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/about/privacy

  • Messenger (facebook.com/dialog/send)
    Data sent: page URL
    Terms: https://www.facebook.com/terms.php
    Privacy: https://www.facebook.com/about/privacy

  • WhatsApp (wa.me / api.whatsapp.com)
    Data sent: quote text and/or page URL
    Terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/
    Privacy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/#privacy-policy

  • Twitter (twitter.com/intent/tweet)
    Data sent: quote text and/or page URL
    Terms: https://twitter.com/en/tos
    Privacy: https://twitter.com/en/privacy

No other external services are contacted. This plugin does not track or store user data.

Support

Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/cap-quote-share/
GitHub Issues: https://github.com/devnajmus/cap-quote-share/issues

License

GPL v2 or later.

Thank You

Thank you for using CAP Quote Share.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins → Add New
  2. Search for CAP Quote Share
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Activate the plugin

Or upload manually to /wp-content/plugins/ and activate.
sections.faq:
Can I use this without shortcode?

Yes. Just use the Classic Editor quote (❝) button.

Is this plugin only for Classic Editor?

It is optimized for Classic Editor but also works with Gutenberg.

Does it slow down my website?

No. The plugin uses minimal CSS and vanilla JavaScript.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes. Fully responsive on all devices.

Does it collect user data?

No. This plugin does not collect or track any user data.
